feat(home): shorter role prompts; the details live in llms.txt

## Intent

The role prompts spelled out how apps are checked and whether externally hosted apps meet the same requirements. That is too much for a prompt to copy, and llms.txt now answers it. The prompts should only ask what the platform is, what it offers the role and how it keeps things safe.

## Key changes

- The teacher, parent and learner prompts ask what lernapps.net is, what it offers them and how it keeps things safe, in German and English.
- The maker's prompt asks what the platform offers makers and what they get back when someone uses their app.

## Dependencies and side effects

- The answer on safety now depends on the section "Sicherheit" of llms.txt (9fa66d8), which is live only after the merge.
